unit.title: The Future, Personal Goals and B1 Integration

theory.title: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple
theory.explanation: Usa el past perfect para mostrar que una acción ocurrió antes que otra acción pasada. Utiliza el pasado simple para narrar la secuencia principal de acontecimientos: When I arrived, the meeting had already started (cuando llegué, la reunión ya había empezado).
theory.tip: Past perfect marca lo que ocurrió antes de otro momento pasado.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 1
patterns.pattern: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
examples:
When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
→ Cuando llegué, la reunión ya había empezado.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 2
patterns.pattern: She had finished the report before the deadline.
examples:
She had finished the report before the deadline.
→ Ella había terminado el informe antes de la fecha límite.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 3
patterns.pattern: We missed the bus because we had left too late.
examples:
We missed the bus because we had left too late.
→ Perdimos el autobús porque habíamos salido demasiado tarde.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 4
patterns.pattern: By the time they called, I had gone home.
examples:
By the time they called, I had gone home.
→ Para cuando llamaron, yo ya me había ido a casa.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 5
patterns.pattern: He realised that he had forgotten his passport.
examples:
He realised that he had forgotten his passport.
→ Se dio cuenta de que había olvidado el pasaporte.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 6
patterns.pattern: After we had checked the details, we booked the tickets.
examples:
After we had checked the details, we booked the tickets.
→ Después de comprobar los detalles, reservamos los billetes.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 7
patterns.pattern: The film had begun when we entered the room.
examples:
The film had begun when we entered the room.
→ La película ya había empezado cuando entramos en la sala.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 8
patterns.pattern: I had never spoken in public before that day.
examples:
I had never spoken in public before that day.
→ Nunca había hablado en público antes de aquel día.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 9
patterns.pattern: They had prepared everything, so the event started on time.
examples:
They had prepared everything, so the event started on time.
→ Lo habían preparado todo, así que el evento empezó a tiempo.

patterns.label: Historias: past perfect y pasado simple · 10
patterns.pattern: When she got the message, she had already made a decision.
examples:
When she got the message, she had already made a decision.
→ Cuando recibió el mensaje, ella ya había tomado una decisión.

content.passage: When Sofia arrived at the interview, the other candidates had already taken their seats. She realised that she had left one document at home, but she had saved a digital copy. Before the interview began, she checked her notes and took a deep breath. The manager asked about a project she had completed the previous year. Sofia answered confidently because she had prepared several examples.

items.prompt: Tell a story about something that had happened before you arrived.
items.modelAnswer: Before I arrived at the station, the train had already left. I had checked the timetable, but I hadn't noticed the platform change. I asked staff for help and caught the next service.

items.prompt: Describe a time you realised you had forgotten something.
items.modelAnswer: I realised I had forgotten my wallet when I reached the café. I had left it on the kitchen table because I was in a hurry. Luckily, my friend paid for lunch, and I returned home to collect it afterwards.

items.prompt: Explain what you had done before an important interview.
items.modelAnswer: Before my job interview, I had researched the company and prepared examples of my work. I had also practised answering common questions with a friend. As a result, I felt calmer when the interview began.

items.prompt: Talk about a film or event that had already started.
items.modelAnswer: When we reached the cinema, the film had already started. We had taken the wrong bus and lost fifteen minutes. The staff showed us to our seats quietly, and we watched the rest of the film.

items.prompt: Describe a decision you had made before receiving new information.
items.modelAnswer: I had decided to accept a new flat before I received the information about the noisy building work nearby. I spoke to the landlord and asked for more details before signing the contract. I was glad I checked first.

items.prompt: Tell a story using by the time and past perfect.
items.modelAnswer: By the time we arrived at the airport, the check-in desk had closed. We had left home late because we couldn't find the car keys. We spoke to the airline and paid to change our flight.

items.prompt: Explain how preparation helped you in a past situation.
items.modelAnswer: Preparation helped me during a presentation because I had checked the room and tested the computer before the audience arrived. When the slides failed, I had printed notes ready and continued without them.

items.prompt: Talk about something you had never done before a certain day.
items.modelAnswer: Before I joined a swimming club, I had never swum in a deep pool. I was nervous on the first day, but the instructor explained the safety rules and helped me practise gradually.

items.prompt: Describe what happened after you had checked some details.
items.modelAnswer: After I had checked the booking details, I noticed that the hotel dates were wrong. I contacted the website immediately, and they corrected the reservation before the payment was taken.

items.prompt: Tell a short story with a clear sequence of past events.
items.modelAnswer: First, I checked the weather and packed my bag. Then I travelled to the station, where I discovered that the train was delayed. I contacted my friend, found another route and eventually arrived safely.
